query: Protocol for isolating primary human mammary epithelial structures and generating normal mammary organoids
title: Isolation, culture, and differentiation of mammary epithelial stem/progenitor cells from fresh or ex vivo cultured human breast tissue
markdown:
## Protocol: Protocol for isolating primary human mammary epithelial structures and generating normal mammary organoids

### Overview

This protocol details the isolation of primary human mammary epithelial structures from breast tissue and their subsequent generation into normal mammary organoids. The process involves tissue digestion, single-cell preparation, sphere selection, 3D culture in Matrigel, and a passage cycle for expansion. All steps must be performed under sterile conditions.

### Materials/Reagents

DMEM/F12 (1:1), BSA (1 mg/mL, sterile filtered), Glutamine (2 mM), Penicillin/Streptomycin (100 U/mL/300 μg/mL), Collagenase, Hyaluronidase (100 U/mL), EGF (10 ng/mL), Cholera toxin (100 ng/mL), Insulin (5 μg/mL), Hydrocortisone (0.5 μg/mL), FBS (5% for digestion medium, 2% for PBS washes), Cold PBS, Ammonium Chloride Solution, Trypsin-EDTA (0.25%), Dispase (5 U/mL), DNase I (100 μg/mL), Trypan blue (0.4%), EpiCult™-B Human Medium, Matrigel.

### Equipment

60 mm culture dishes, 15 mL or 50 mL polypropylene conical centrifuge tubes, Scissors, Vortex mixer, Centrifuge (capable of 700g at 4°C), Microscope, Blunt end Hamilton® syringe, 1 mL pipette, 200 μL pipette, 1.5 mL tubes, 24-well ultra-low attachment plate (Corning 3473), 40-μm strainers (FALCON, CAT# 352360 or equivalent), 100-μm strainer (for fibrous tissue).

### Safety & Sterility

All procedures involving cell handling must be performed under sterile conditions. Tissue processing steps requiring rapid execution to maintain yield should be performed on ice. Use appropriate personal protective equipment when handling biological samples and chemical reagents such as Trypsin and Ammonium Chloride.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-dissection

1. Prior to dissection, prepare the digestion medium by supplementing DMEM/F12 (1:1) with 1 mg/mL BSA (sterile by filtration), 2 mM glutamine, Penicillin/Streptomycin (100 U/mL penicillin / 300 μg/mL streptomycin), collagenase, 100 U/mL hyaluronidase, 10 ng/mL epidermal growth factor (EGF), 100 ng/mL cholera toxin, 5 μg/mL insulin, 0.5 μg/mL hydrocortisone, and 5% FBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->

## Single Mammary Cells Preparation

### Tissue Preparation

1. Rinse 0.3 to 5 grams of breast tissue with cold PBS, transfer the tissue to a 60 mm culture dish placed on ice, and rapidly mince the tissue with scissors to obtain a pulp. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. Add the digestion medium to the minced tissue at a weight (gram) to volume (mL) ratio of 2:3, transfer the mixture to a 15 mL or 50 mL polypropylene conical centrifuge tube, loosen the cap, and incubate for 18 hours at 37°C in a tissue culture incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This step must be performed on ice and done rapidly; otherwise, the yield of epithelial cells will decrease. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: If the tissue weight is less than 2 grams, digest it in 3 mL of digestion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->

### Remove Fat and Lyse Red Cells

1. Vortex the tube gently and intermittently for 15 seconds, stop the digestion by adding cold 1X PBS containing 2% FBS, mix gently by inverting the tube, and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->
2. Discard the supernatant containing adipose cells/tissue, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of 1X PBS containing 2% FBS, add 8 mL of Ammonium Chloride Solution to lyse red cells, incubate for 5 minutes on ice, and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S02 -->

### Prepare Single Cells

1. Discard the supernatant, add 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA, and gently pipette up and down for 3 minutes using a 1 mL pipette. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S01 -->
2. Stop the trypsinization by adding 10 mL of cold 1X PBS containing 2% FBS and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S02 -->
3. Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) 5 U/mL dispase containing 100 μg/mL DNase I, gently pipette up and down for 3 minutes, and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S03 -->
4. Stop the dispase digestion by adding 10 mL of cold 1X PBS containing 2% FBS, filter the digested tissue through a 40-μm strainer, and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes at 4°C. If the tissue is very fibrous, filter through a 100-μm strainer (FALCON, CAT# 352360) instead. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S04 -->
5. Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1X PBS (100-200 μL depending on pellet size to achieve 1×10^7 cells/mL for flow cytometry analysis), count the cells, and evaluate viability using 0.4% Trypan blue, which dyes dead cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S05 -->

## 3D Organoid Differentiation and Passage

### Organoid Generation

1. Prepare complete EpiCult™-B Human Medium for 3D-organoid culture according to Table 4. Note: Complete EpiCult™-B Human Medium must be used within one week when stored at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S01 -->
2. Transfer all spheres derived from the same tissue sample into a 60-mm dish. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S02 -->
3. Using a microscope under sterile conditions, manually pick a total of 30 spheres using a blunt-end Hamilton® syringe and transfer them into a 1.5 mL tube containing 25 μL of cold EpiCult™-B Human Medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S03 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: The volume of medium containing spheres in the syringe should not exceed 5 μL. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S04 -->
4. Gently mix the spheres with 25 μL of Matrigel and plate the sphere-Matrigel mixture as a droplet onto a pre-warmed (in a 37°C incubator) 24-well ultra-low attachment plate for the sphere differentiation assay. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S05 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Gently mix the spheres with Matrigel to avoid bubbles before plating. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S06 -->
5. Allow the droplet to solidify inside a 37°C incubator for 15 minutes, then cover with 500 μL of complete EpiCult™ Human Medium and incubate at 37°C for 9 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S07 -->
6. Allow the droplet to solidify inside a 37°C incubator for 15 minutes, then cover with 500 μL of complete EpiCult™ Human Medium and incubate at 37°C for 9 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S08 -->
7. Count the number of 3D-organoids with a diameter greater than 100 μm. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S09 -->

### Passage Cycle

1. Discard most of the liquid medium in the well with a pipette, transfer the Matrigel containing 3D-organoids to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube, pipette up and down with a 200 μL pipette to break the Matrigel, and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S01 -->
2. Discard the supernatant, add 300 μL of pre-warmed (37°C) 5 U/mL dispase to digest/dissolve the Matrigel, incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes, and gently pipette up and down every 5 minutes to resuspend the organoids. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S02 -->
3. Stop the dispase digestion by adding 1 mL of 1X PBS containing 2% FBS and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S03 -->
4. Discard the supernatant, resuspend the organoid pellet in 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA, and gently pipette up and down for 3 minutes to break organoids into single cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S04 -->
5. Stop the trypsinization by adding 1 mL of 1X PBS containing 2% FBS and centrifuge at 700g for 5 minutes at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S05 -->
6. Discard the supernatant, gently resuspend the single cells in a small volume (<50 μL) of EpiCult™-B Human Medium to count them, mix 1,000-5,000 cells with 30 μL of Matrigel, and plate the cell-gel droplet onto a pre-warmed 24-well ultra-low attachment plate (Corning 3473) for 3D-organoid generation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S06 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Gently mix the single cells with Matrigel to avoid bubbles. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S07 -->
7. Allow the sphere-gel droplet to solidify inside a 37°C incubator for 15 minutes, cover with 500 μL of complete EpiCult™ Human Medium, and incubate at 37°C for 9 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S08 -->
8. Count the number of 3D organoids with a diameter greater than 100 μm. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S09 -->
9. Step7 through 14 can be repeated as many times as needed according to the purpose of the experiment. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S10 -->
